requirements.text: 3 to 10 years of software engineering experience, including personal ownership of production backend systems.

This opportunity allows you to design, build, and operate backend services that transform large datasets through multiple processing stages. You will own systems from architecture and implementation through monitoring, debugging, and recovery.
Meaningful full-time experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup, with responsibility for decisions and delivery in an evolving environment.
A relevant undergraduate STEM degree from a top-30 U.S. institution.
Strong distributed-systems fundamentals, including concurrency, idempotency, retries, partial failures, and safe recovery.
Proficiency in a general-purpose backend language, such as Python, Go, Rust, or Java.
Ability to work onsite in Brooklyn five days each week.
